name: comms
description: Comms Desk. Adaptive writing-voice plugin (renamed from writing-style, 2026-09-15; renamed from voice, 2026-09-15). Now a Nucleus starter plugin alongside cortex and ops. Owns /setup-voice — the one-time voice-capture interview (moved from cortex, 2026-09-15), writing to the Cortex-owned canonical file `<config-root>/memory/me/voice.md` — plus continuous adaptive learning from real edits. Draft-first workflow for emails, posts, docs — including the weekly roundup post via /post, which drafts from research's staged candidates using the post-assembler agent. Detects patterns across 2+ recurrences before committing style-guide updates. Research finds; Comms Desk writes.
